description: Owner 2026-10-17: try tools4imps/covenant (0.2, MIT, externally maintained) as the mechanism for stability over time and to replace some unit tests. Write a Covenant contract (obligations, tagged contract tests, decision records), run covenant.check and covenant.mutate, freeze-able per version (covenant.check --contracts/--test-path runs an old contract against new code). Compare with test/stability/ rejections + codes.txt + stability_*_test.exs and compile_errors_test.exs. Favour Covenant where it is equivalent (externally maintained vs our own invention). Deliver: contract + tests + a written comparison.
